= Cloud October 2, 2026

[NOTE]
====
Cloud release notes are typically published weekly and summarize changes since the previous publication. Kobiton uses date-based release versioning, with releases identified by the build date in YYMM.DD format. Version information for individual software components is available in the Component versions section.
====

== iPhone and iOS support

This release adds:

* Support for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.
* Kobiton-managed passcodes for devices running iOS 27.

// Source: KOB-55195 from PR #646
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/646

== Hosting iOS 12-14 devices

Apple's recent releases of iOS 27, macOS 27, and Xcode 27 introduce compatibility considerations for Kobiton device labs. If your device lab includes devices running iOS 12, 13, or 14, please contact Kobiton support for installation and configuration information.

// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55195): The Supported OS versions page and the Prepare an iOS device page
// are updated in the same branch. Those updates were authored for the earlier "iOS 15 minimum"
// framing; verify they still align with the reframed "contact support" guidance before publishing.

// Source: KOB-54432 from PR #665
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/665

== Appium Inspector

- *Appium Inspector* in Session Explorer now shows the correct XML hierarchy for each step of iPad automation sessions started without an app, such as a web session in Safari. This matches the behavior on iPhone and Android. Previously, these sessions showed the same hierarchy for every step.

// Source: KOB-55247 from PR #662
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/662

== iOS system alerts in automation sessions

- Automation sessions on iOS and iPadOS can now interact with system alerts, such as the alert that asks you to turn on Location Services. Scripts can locate the alert button, read its `displayed` and `enabled` properties, and click it. Previously, these commands could fail with a `No active application elements` error.

// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55247): The Jira impact field describes the fix as covering alerts and
// popups drawn by the iOS system on iPhone and iPad. QA verified the Location Services alert
// only. Confirm that the general "system alerts" wording is acceptable.

// Source: KOB-54691 from PR #647
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/647

== Java 17 support for generated Appium scripts

- Appium scripts generated for Java now use Java 17, Appium Java client 10.x, and Selenium 4 for compatibility with current Java frameworks.
- JDK 17 or later is required to build and run newly generated Java Appium scripts.
- Scripts generated from test cases created before this release do not support Java 17. To use Java 17, you will need to create a new test case.

// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-54691): Confirm Standalone availability separately.

// Source: KOB-55058 from PR #645
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/645

== License configuration for new deviceConnect deployments

- Starting with *deviceConnect* 2610.1, new deployments require an additional license configuration step before *deviceConnect* can initialize. Existing deployments require no changes.

// Source: KOB-54451 from PR #643
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/643
// Source: KOB-54450 from PR #650
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/650

== Virtual device visibility in the API

- `GET /v2/devices` now includes available Android emulators in the `virtual_devices` list.
